findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_shelves, check_carrier_authority, check_carrier_basics, check_broker_authority, vet_load, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, get_diaspora_metro_snapshot, get_fx_official, get_fx_parallel, get_fx_africa_brief, localize_text, check_tx_insurance_ce, check_tx_realestate_ce, buy_shelf_pass, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff · Private data: get_pass_balance, check_carrier_authority, check_broker_authority, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, get_diaspora_metro_snapshot, buy_shelf_pass · Public sink: check_carrier_basics, vet_load, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff · Destructive: localize_text, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_shelves, check_carrier_authority, check_carrier_basics, check_broker_authority, vet_load, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, get_diaspora_metro_snapshot, get_fx_official, get_fx_parallel, get_fx_africa_brief, localize_text, check_tx_insurance_ce, check_tx_realestate_ce, buy_shelf_pass, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff · Private data: get_pass_balance, check_carrier_authority, check_broker_authority, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, get_diaspora_metro_snapshot, buy_shelf_pass · Public sink: check_carrier_basics, vet_load, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff · Destructive: localize_text, prepare_us_nigeria_shipment_handoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
